pages.text:
Chateau History - Chateau Challain Skip to the content
Chateau History
Medieval Ages
1050
The earliest recorded chateau on our site dates all the way back to the medieval age in 1050, in a time of knights and chivalry. The original castle was probably part of the ‘Les Marches de Bretagne’ a series of fortresses that acted as a defensive line that protected the people of the ancient region of France known as Brittany. That chateau, and many others that followed it were destroyed in the wars, and conflicts that wracked the area in the centuries that followed.
Early 1800s
Louise-Ida de La Potherie
But our story truly starts with Louise-Ida de La Potherie, an exceptional woman that lived through some of France’s most turbulent times. She was the last of her line, from a noble family steeped in history. Her was father a famous colonel that fought in the Spanish wars, and against the forces of revolution, her only brother was killed in a duel.
1847
Constructing a Masterpiece
Alone, in this difficult period she finally found the love of her life, Le comte de La Rochefoucauld-Bayers. They married, and sought to make a refuge for themselves in the seat of her ancestral home. Together they set about to build a sanctuary, a testament of their love, and it is this monument that we know as the ‘Chateau Challain’. Work began in 1847, they commissioned Parisian architect Louis Visconti, famed for designing the Louvre extension, to replace the original 16th century castle.
1847
The Intricate Details
The owners chose Rene Hode, a well-known Angevin architect to oversee the building project. The chateau was designed to commemorate the passing of time. Its 4 towers represent the seasons, 12 turrets represent the lunar months, 26 spiral staircases represent the fortnights per year, 52 fireplaces represent the weeks of the year, and 365 windows represent each passing day. It covers an area of 7,600 square meters (nearly 82,000 square feet).
1854
Construction Completed
Over 700 artisans worked on the construction, and although worked progressed quickly it was far from straightforward, with the work being delayed by yet another revolution in 1848. With the work close to completion tragedy struck once more. In the early winter of 1854, and in the shadow of the nearly completed chateau Le Comte died. Heartbroken, and with two children, Louise, now Countess La Rochefoucauld-Bayers, was determined to see the project through to the end, and personally oversaw the final stages of construction.
Late 1800s
Neo-Gothic Jewel of Anjou
Ultimately, the chateau became one of the grandest private French homes of the 19th century. It boasts a wealth of architectural detail, including intricate woodcarvings, Gothic panelling and sculptures, large working fireplaces, and hand painted ceilings. It is situated on a beautifully manicured estate, which occupies one corner of a quaint village. Because of the property’s ambiance and the design of the castle itself, Chateau Challain is often referred to as the "Neo-Gothic Jewel of Anjou" or "Le Petite Chambord.”
2002
A Beautiful Restoration
In 2002, the Nicholson family purchased Chateau Challain and began the painstaking process of restoring the castle to its original splendour. Together with an international team of craftsman, the Nicholsons continue to restore, preserve, and protect this valuable piece of French history.
Present Day
A Dream Come True
Today, Chateau Challain stands as the epitome of a Fairytale French Chateau. Voted one of the top 10 destination wedding venues in France, it offers the most luxurious setting to make the event of your dreams come true.

A Luxury Wedding Destination Location
Chateau Challain Weddings
Chateau Challain: One of the Best Destination Wedding Locations in France
Your Exquisite Destination Wedding Location in France
Welcome to Chateau Challain, one of the exquisite destination wedding locations in France that epitomize elegance, romance, and enchantment. Nestled in the breathtaking Loire Valley, our stunning estate offers an idyllic backdrop for couples seeking an unforgettable destination wedding experience.
Discover why Chateau Challain is the perfect choice among France s most sought-after destination wedding locations. Imagine exchanging vows in a fairytale castle nestled in the heart of France, surrounded by breathtaking beauty and immersed in a world of romance.
This castle, renowned among France s top destination wedding locations, fulfils your wedding dreams with its captivating charm and timeless allure. From its rich history to its picturesque surroundings, every aspect of Chateau Challain exudes elegance and creates an unforgettable destination wedding experience.
Book a Call
Why Chateau Challain is one of the best destination locations in France
We offer three Luxury Wedding Packages for your chateau wedding, based on the most requested services from our wedding packages.
Each of our Intimate Affairs, Gold, and Platinum wedding packages can be tailored to your individual desires. High season is April 1st to October 31st and all holidays.
Over the years, we have fulfilled requests for gymnasts, fire acrobats, caricature artists, water colourists, Disney plays, cover bands, mimes, singing waiters, archery, ice skating, hot air balloon rides and more.

Share The Love
Celebrate your love and share this unforgettable experience with your cherished guests at Chateau Challain. Indulge in the joy of creating lifelong memories together, surrounded by the opulence and splendor of our exclusive destination wedding location. With its grandeur and charm, Chateau Challain sets the stage for an extraordinary celebration that will leave a lasting impression on your loved ones. Allow us to pamper you and your guests, ensuring every detail is meticulously planned and executed to perfection.
From luxurious accommodations to exquisite dining experiences, we take pride in providing an exceptional level of service that will impress even the most discerning guests. At Chateau Challain, your destination wedding becomes an opportunity to create cherished moments, where your loved ones can bask in the beauty and elegance of this extraordinary setting.
Chateau Wedding Ceremony
Your ceremony can be held anywhere in the chateau or its grounds. A popular location with brides is the gazebo overlooking the lake which we can decorate in any style you choose. The Memorial Tower and woods are also popular locations for ceremonies. The choice is, as always, yours.
Church Wedding Ceremony
The church in Challain-la-Potherie is directly opposite Chateau Challain only a few minutes walk. The 18th century church can be decorated to your taste and your vows can be taken with the local clergy or your own. Design a bespoke ceremony or have a traditional service we ll help you with all arrangements.
Wedding Reception
Our four or five course wedding reception prepared by top-chefs will delight you with a selection of delicious canapés, a choice of cocktails, Mis en Bouche, delicate starters, mouth-watering mains and French desserts. Our hog-roasts and BBQs are very popular we can cater to any request.
Bar and Drinks
Beer and wine is included in your wedding reception and rehearsal dinner package. We also offer a wide selection of champagne, cocktails, spirits and soft drinks from our bar. The bar stays open til 11pm, or if you choose, an extended bar can run til 1am. Children drink free all weekend and suites have tea and coffee making facilities. Fridges are also available.
Wedding Planning
With 20 years experience, Cynthia knows that your wedding is one of the most magical experiences of your life and that you want everything to be perfect. To that end, Cynthia will ensure your wedding day meets all your expectations and more.
Wedding Decorations
The wedding decorations don t have to stop at flowers and garlands. If you have a theme in mind or specific request please let Cynthia know. We ve hosted masquerade balls, made giant chess boards, held 1920 s theme parties and much more. Our experts can help design and decorate the chateau and grounds in whatever theme you like.
Firework & Pyrotechnics
No wedding celebration should be without a BIG fireworks display to finish off the perfect wedding day. With a range of fireworks and pyrotechnics packages you can be sure your wedding day will end with a bang. In fact, we ve hosted fire-breathers and dragons, fire-showers and displays to rival any major global display.
Music and DJs
From the gentle notes of our resident harpist to the more up-beat tunes of one of our DJs we ll make sure your party has whatever style of music suits your taste. Choose from our roster of entertainers: harpist, pianist, a jazz band, choir, string quartet, DJ, singers and cover bands to get your guests dancing. You can even plug-in your own Spotify playlist.
Photography & Videography
Our resident photographers and film makers can will capture every moment of your wedding day. The chateau and surrounding areas are steeped with romanticism and will make the perfect setting for your wedding photos. Whether you want documentary style, traditional poses or a combination, our photographers are on-hand throughout the wedding.

On your first night at the chateau, we ll prepare a delicious Rehearsal

wikipedia.title: Château de Challain-la-Potherie
wikipedia.extract: The Château de Challain-la-Potherie is a castle located in the French commune of Challain-la-Potherie, in Maine-et-Loire. Constructed between 1847 and 1854 in the neo-Gothic style, the Château de Challain-la-Potherie is a notable example of French architectural heritage. René Hodé, the architect responsible for the design, is also known for his work on numerous other castles in the same style in Anjou. Its considerable size and impressive grandeur have earned it the sobriquet "Petit Chambord" or "Chambord angevin."
